latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Reference Creator skill for OpenClaw.

- Provides structured guidelines and interviewing process for creating reference files describing agent professions.
- Enforces strict separation of competencies: one reference = one narrow specialization.
- Includes mandatory YAML frontmatter and section ordering for all reference files.
- Outlines standard interview questions and validation steps to ensure reference quality and accuracy.
- Prevents reference duplication and role overlap through built-in comparison and confirmation rules.
